items.briefing:
Australian businesses are deploying AI tools faster than policies and controls can keep up, raising concerns about data handling, decision-making risks, and compliance gaps. Separately, AI is increasingly being used on both sides of mortgage fraud — helping detect suspicious activity but also potentially enabling more sophisticated scams. Staff should be cautious about how they use AI tools at work, particularly when handling sensitive client or financial information.

**Practical tip:** Before using any AI tool for work tasks, check with your manager or IT team that it's approved — not all AI tools handle your data safely or in line with your organisation's policies.

featured.title: AI is the new battleground in mortgage fraud detection
featured.quote: AI-generated fraud is outpacing lenders' detection capabilities, threatening financial system integrity.
